materials.text:
1
VOCABULARY WORKSHEET-1
Synonyms
1. Capitalize– It’s important to capitalize on every opportunity.
A) Waste
B) Use
C) Ignore
D) Cancel
2. Clarify – Can you clarify your last point?
A) Confuse
B) Hide
C) Explain
D) Complicate
3. Commit – She decided to commit to the project full-time.
A) Withdraw
B) Promise
C) Lie
D) Hesitate
4. Compare– Let's compare the prices before we buy.
A) Ignore
B) Evaluate
C) Isolate
D) Reject
5. Confirm– Please confirm your attendance by Monday.
A) Doubt
B) Cancel
C) Verify
D) Deny
6. Connect– We need to connect these wires carefully.
A) Separate
B) Join
C) Detach
D) Remove
7. Contribute – She likes to contribute ideas during team meetings.
A) Withhold
B) Take
C) Give
D) Hoard
8. Convince– He tried to convince her to stay.
A) Persuade
B) Reject
C) Hesitate
D) Distract
9. Coordinate– They need to coordinate efforts for the event.
A) Mix
B) Disorganize
C) Organize
D) Break
10. Create– The designer wants to create a new logo.
A) Destroy
B) Conceal
C) Build
D) Reduce

-- 1 of 15 --

2
VOCABULARY WORKSHEET-1
Suffix
11. What does the suffix "-ism" generally indicate?
A. A tool
B. A belief or practice
C. A disease
D. A profession
12. What does the suffix "-ate" in "educate" indicate?
A. A profession
B. A place
C. To make or do
D. A description
13. What does the suffix "-en" in "widen" imply?
A. Condition
B. To make or become
C. A person
D. An adjective
14. What does the suffix "-ify" in "beautify" mean?
A. A person who
B. To make
C. Like or similar
D. Related to sound
15. The suffix "-ize" in "modernize" means:
A. To reduce
B. To destroy
C. To become or make
D. To repeat
16. The word "democracy" includes the suffix "-acy," which
means:
A. Rule or government
B. Disease
C. Movement
D. Belonging to
17. The suffix "-dom" in "freedom" means:
A. Person
B. Condition or state
C. Profession
D. Illness
18. The suffix "-esque" as in "picturesque" means:
A. Sound
B. Fear
C. In the style of
D. One who performs
19. The suffix "-ive" in "active" generally forms:
A. A verb
B. An adjective
C. A noun
D. An adverb
20. The suffix "-ary" in "missionary" usually means:
A. Related to or belonging to
B. A person who flies
C. A place
D. A measurement
Antonyms

-- 2 of 15 --

3
VOCABULARY WORKSHEET-1
21. What is the antonym of Open?
A. Start
B. Close
C. Unseal
D. Unlock
22. What is the antonym of Overestimate?
A. Underestimate
B. Overvalue
C. Exaggerate
D. Misjudge
23. What is the antonym of Pass?
A. Succeed
B. Advance
C. Fail
D. Proceed
24. What is the antonym of Permit?
A. Approve
B. Authorize
C. Forbid
D. Consent
25. What is the antonym of Plenty?
A. Few
B. Scarcity
C. Many
D. Enough
26. What is the antonym of Praise?
A. Applaud
B. Celebrate
C. Criticize
D. Admire
27. What is the antonym of Present?
A. Absent
B. Gift
C. Appear
D. Offer
28. What is the antonym of Produce?
A. Make
B. Create
C. Destroy
D. Manufacture
29. What is the antonym of Profit?
A. Earnings
B. Income
C. Loss
D. Revenue
30. What is the antonym of Protect?
A. Guard
B. Defend
C. Harm
D. Shield
Analogy
31. Balance Sheet is to Assets as:
A. Budget : Allocation
B. Ledger : Entries

-- 3 of 15 --

4
VOCABULARY WORKSHEET-1
C. Income Statement : Revenue
D. Report : File

A. Sale : Discount
B. Design : Packaging
C. Offer : Hire
D. Launch : Deal

D. Order : Delivery

B. Rule : Idea
C. Memo : Email
D. Strategy : Approval

A. Research : Discovery
B. Report : Data
C. Money : Marketing
D. Market : Competition
36. Team is to Collaboration as:
A. Group : Unity
B. Worker : Stress
C. Plan : Meeting
D. Role : Responsibility

A. Automation : Efficiency
B. Hiring : Training
C. Supply : Inventory
D. Budget : Investment

A. Candidate : Resume
B. Company : Advertisement
C. Market : Strategy
D. Investor : Return
39. Supply is to Demand as:
A. Input : Output
B. Produce : Product
C. Storage : Goods
D. Quantity : Quality
40. Asset is to Value as:
A. Investment : Return
B. Balance : Sheet
C. Report : Performance
D. Budget : Allocation

41. He will present his findings to the board.
A. Hide
B. Refuse
C. Show formally
D. Package
42. She gave me a beautiful present for my birthday.
A. Time
B. Gift

VOCABULARY WORKSHEET-1
C. Prize
D. Card
43. The audience was content with the performance.
A. Annoyed
B. Satisfied
C. Disappointed
D. Angry
44. The book’s content includes images and charts.
A. Happiness
B. Purpose
C. Material inside
D. Format
45. It took just one minute to solve the puzzle.
A. Hour
B. Short time
C. Time pass
D. Schedule
46. That insect is so minute I can hardly see it.
A. Giant
B. Loud
C. Tiny
D. Strong
47. They signed a contract to rent the office space.
A. Agreement
B. Rejection
C. Deal
D. Bond
48. Muscles contract when you exercise.
A. Grow
B. Expand
C. Shrink
D. Freeze
49. The pass was invalid because it had expired.
A. Fake
B. Not valid
C. Digital
D. Cancelled
50. The invalid needed rest and medical care.
A. Tourist
B. Officer
C. Sick person
D. Volunteer

51. The root "sect" means:
A. Group
B. Part or cut
C. Rule
D. Think
52. "Spect" in the word "inspect" means:
A. Look
B. Check
C. See
D. Touch

VOCABULARY WORKSHEET-1
53. What does "struct" mean?
A. Fire
B. Build
C. Clean
D. Turn
54. The root "tele" means:
A. Far or distance
B. Fast
C. Travel
D. Talk
55. "Therm" in a word like "thermometer" means:
A. Time
B. Speed
C. Heat
D. Cold
56. What does "vid" mean?
A. Hear
B. See
C. Touch
D. Say
57. The root "vis" also means:
A. See
B. Love
C. Speak
D. Think
58. "Voc" in "vocal" means:
A. Word
B. Speak or call
C. Loud
D. Repeat
59. The root "aqua" means:
A. Blue
B. River
C. Water
D. Clear
60. "Astro" as in "astronomy" means:
A. Time
B. Earth
C. Star
D. Light
Phrasal Verbs
61. She hopes to get into Harvard.
A. Enter or be accepted
B. Graduate from
C. Travel to
D. Avoid
62. The cat wanted to get out of the box.
A. Stay
B. Escape or leave
C. Hide
D. Sleep
63. It took her months to get over the breakup.
A. Return
B. Recover
C. Argue
D. Stay sad

-- 6 of 15 --

7
VOCABULARY WORKSHEET-1
64. We’ll get through this difficult time.
A. Finish or overcome
B. Delay
C. Escape
D. Sleep
65. Don’t give up so easily!
A. Succeed
B. Try harder
C. Quit
D. Laugh
66. You may go ahead with your question.
A. Cancel
B. Begin or proceed
C. Skip
D. Delay
67. Let’s go over the details again.
A. Ignore
B. Review
C. Write
D. Copy
68. I had to go through the documents.
A. Destroy
B. Skip
C. Examine or experience
D. Collect
69. Don’t forget to hand in your homework.
A. Return something
B. Pick up
C. Tear
D. Copy
70. The teacher will hand out the worksheets.
A. Tear up
B. Distribute
C. Read aloud
D. Write
Collocations
71. Please feel free to---------a question at the end.
A. Ask
B. Set
C. Show
D. Send

VOCABULARY WORKSHEET-1

A. Reach
B. Make
C. Build
D. Create
73. You must ------------a proposal before the deadline.
A. Offer
B. Submit
C. Create
D. Take
74. The CEO will personally-----------the issue.
A. Accept
B. Address
C. Avoid
D. Close
75. The goal of our new product is to-----revenue.
A. Generate
B. Deliver
C. Sign
D. Attend
76. They plan to------- a conference in Dubai.
A. Take
B. Attend
C. Submit
D. Follow
77. A leader should-----------a strong team.
A. Set
B. Build (✓)
C. Sign
D. Create
78. You cannot launch without first---------approval.
A. Giving
B. Gaining
C. Setting
D. Reaching
79. She will ------the position of Vice President.
A. Follow
B. Build
C. Hold
D. Deal
80. We hired a coach to ------ performance.
A. Improve
B. Find
C. Ask
D. Measure
Homonyms

-- 8 of 15 --

9
VOCABULARY WORKSHEET-1
81. Word: Fly
Sentence: A fly is buzzing around.
What is another meaning of "fly"?
A. To move through the air
B. A type of toy
C. A jump
D. A snack
82. Word: Game
Sentence: The hunters spotted game in the forest.
What is another meaning of "game"?
A. A fun activity or sport
B. A tool
C. A group
D. A blanket
83. Word: Glass
Sentence: He poured juice into a glass.
What is another meaning of "glass"?
A. A transparent material used in windows
B. A mirror
C. A plate
D. A type of cloth
84. Word: Head
Sentence: The head of the company gave a speech.
What is another meaning of "head"?
A. The top part of the human body
B. A building
C. A signature
D. A number
85. Word: Jam
Sentence: There’s a traffic jam on the highway.
What is another meaning of "jam"?
A. A fruit spread
B. A playlist
C. A box
D. A coin
86. Word: Kind
Sentence: She is a very kind person.
What is another meaning of "kind"?
A. A type or category
B. A taste
C. A brand
D. A fruit
87. Word: Letter
Sentence: I wrote a letter to my friend.
What is another meaning of "letter"?
A. A character in the alphabet
B. A symbol
C. A number
D. A note
88. Word: Light
Sentence: Turn on the light.
What is another meaning of "light"?
A. Not heavy
B. Bright color
C. Flame
D. Spark

-- 9 of 15 --

10
VOCABULARY WORKSHEET-1
89. Word: Log
Sentence: He wrote in his travel log.
What is another meaning of "log"?
A. A piece of a tree trunk
B. A ticket
C. A sound
D. A mask
90. Word: Match
Sentence: The tennis match lasted two hours.
What is another meaning of "match"?
A. A stick for making fire
B. A racket
C. A score
D. A referee
Homophones
91. Bare / Bear
The floor was cold on my-----------feet.
A. Bear
B. Bare
C. Bar
D. Bore
92. Bare / Bear
A grizzly---------------can be dangerous in the wild.
A. Bare
B. Bear
C. Beer
D. Boar
93. Break / Brake
Don't forget to------------when the light turns red.
A. Break
B. Brake
C. Brook
D. Braid
94. Break / Brake
He needed a short------------during work.
A. Brake
B. Break
C. Braid
D. Brook
95. Cell / Sell
Each prisoner was locked in a separate ------___.
A. Sell
B. Cell
C. Seal
D. Sil
96. Cell / Sell
They want to ---------------their old furniture.
A. Cell
B. Sell
C. Sale
D. Sail

A. Course
B. Coarse

A. With

A. Against
